dct_description_sm: Guide defines Prime Farmland, Unique Farmland, Additional Farmland of Statewide Importance, Additional Farmland of Local Importance and lists the soil mapping units for Prime Farmland and Additional Farmland of Statewide Importance.

Shows "prime farmland", "unique farmland, other than prime", "additional farmland of statewide importance", "additional farmland of local importance", and "other land."; "Base Source: USGS 1:100,000 county base map compiled in 1976."; "Interpretations derived from soil map constructed in 1967 by Cartographic Division, Soil Conservation Service, USDA, of Columbia County, Pennsylvania."; "May 1977."; Includes location map and inset extending the main map south.
1 map :color ;112 cm x 92 cm + guide (6 unnumbered pages ; 28 cm)
